launches.title: Veriad: AI compliance officers
launches.tagline: Automating marketing compliance so brands don't get cancelled or sued
launches.body:
Hi all, we’re Anton and Rohan, founders of Veriad.

**TL;DR**

Marketing teams are being held back by manual content reviews. Veriad automatically checks whether content is compliant with brand and legal guidelines so they can publish 10x faster.

**Want to see Veriad in action? Book a demo here:**

<https://cal.com/team/veriad/veriad-introduction>

**Our Launch Video:**

<https://youtu.be/rsdj3FqUE9U>

**Why This Matters**

Companies spend $1T on ads every year. $100B is wasted on ineffective ads due to non-compliance with brand guidelines, regulations, and platform best practices. So millions of lawyers, marketers, and compliance officers manually review every piece of content.

This process is slow, expensive, and about to break - AI tools are letting teams create 100x more content and human reviewers won’t be able to keep up.

**Our solution**

Veriad automates the entire process at scale. Our agent ingests brand policies, industry guidelines, and precedents, then analyzes every piece of content automatically - providing instant feedback to marketers. Veriad integrates directly into your marketing stack, to ensure that brand equity is protected across all surface areas.

**Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97377&key=user_uploads/891759/79a75d50-6908-41d1-9369-1d2086d23ab5)

We met working at CoLoop (YC S21) where Rohan joined as employee #7 as a founding engineer and built out the agentic product line, and Anton advised the founders on GTM and Growth, having previously closed 7-figure deals with Fortune 10-500 companies.

**Get in touch**

If you know/work at a consumer-facing company that fits **any of these** criteria, we’d love to chat:

* Ad spend of $50M or more annually
* Operates in an industry where advertising is regulated
* Reviews thousands of marketing assets annually
* Has a content review team / process
* Faces bottlenecks in their ad approval workflows, with long waiting times

Please get in touch with us at [anton@veriad.ai](mailto:anton@veriad.ai) / [rohan@veriad.ai](mailto:rohan@veriad.ai)  or check out our website [veriad.ai](http://veriad.ai) to learn more and book a demo!
